title: Commercial pilot films mysterious lights after repeated UFO sightings
excerpt: A commercial airline pilot says he has repeatedly spotted mysterious UFO-like lights while flying over Europe - and has now captured them on camera.
content:
A commercial airline pilot says he has repeatedly spotted mysterious UFO-like lights while flying over Europe – and has now captured them on camera.

Steve Frazer, 48, has been a commercial pilot for 27 years and a captain for 20.

He first noticed the strange lights in 2022 while flying near Brussels, Belgium, when he spotted what appeared to be an aircraft circling in the distance.

Since then, he says he has seen the same flashing lights “six or seven” times, most recently in October 2026.

Steve initially thought they might be military aircraft refueling, but says their speed and movements didn’t make sense to him.

Time-lapse footage he captured during a flight shows small points of light appearing to move across the night sky before disappearing.

Steve says other pilots have also reported seeing similar lights, although their origin remains unknown.

Steve, from Sandbach, Cheshire, England, said: “I saw these lights when I was working and another colleague saw the lights coming back from Lithuania.

“We saw them in the same space and roughly the same direction but it was ever so strange.

“I just thought it was a military refuelling aircraft but the way it was moving and speed, it didn’t make any sense.

“We were going towards them for seemingly ages and never got to them.

“That was a few years ago and I didn’t think much about it.

“I did a couple of flights recently and saw them again.

“I’ve been flying 27 years commercially and it doesn’t fit with anything I’ve seen previously.

“Technically in a sense it’s an unidentified object that seems to be flying.

“It looked to me it was coming over the Atlantic, it looked beyond the UK.”

Steve says he isn’t the only pilot to have noticed the mysterious lights.

He recalls another pilot radioing to ask whether there was any military activity in the area in October 2026.

Steve has since researched the sightings online but says he hasn’t been able to identify what he saw.

Speaking to Talk to the Press, he said: “I’ve done my own digging to try and figure out what they are and I can’t find an answer to it.

“I know what satellites normally look like, I’ve seen plenty of Starlinks and things like that.

“They don’t fit with that movement.

“In the little video you see the lights coming up from the ground and I seem to recall it was Brussels coming into view back towards the UK – it’s always north-westerly heading.

“I’ve done a little research online and other people have reported this but I don’t think anyone has recorded it, not that I’ve seen anyway.

“Some people flying in the Netherlands saw it as well and made a report through a media channel but I’m not entirely sure.

“It seems to fit with what other pilots have commented on when they’ve seen them.”
